title: Protect live fractional claims during process-session retention
outcome: Protect live fractional claims during process-session retention
acceptance: A process-default holder session with a fractional claim expiry is retained strictly before that exact expiry within its final millisecond, along with its completed protocol attempts, while the exact claim mutation guard still reports it live.
At exact expiry and afterward, retention follows the documented conservative policy without extending mutation authority; deterministic boundary tests cover both sides.

completion.summary: Preserved process sessions and completed protocol attempts through a fractional claim's expiry millisecond, with exact mutation authority unchanged. Delivered both unchanged acceptance criteria; independently passed 2/2, full gate and Codex/Claude reviews clean. Pushed and installed the validated changes.
